verdicts.reason: A reflows the headline into four large, well-broken lines that fill the square and dominate. However, the bottom row splits the centred axis: the centre-aligned three-line subcopy sits ragged in a left column (its edges don't match the headline's) beside an off-centre CTA, so the base looks improvised. B is a clean, faithful centred stack, but it's essentially the banner scaled up: the headline runs almost edge to edge (~50px margins), the subcopy is one long line nearly touching the sides, and wide empty orange bands sit above and below, so it doesn't use the square format.
